sentences.text: A single mission can contain at most 256 waypoints, so 256 waypoints is the longest route you can submit as one mission.
A body that exceeds this limit is rejected with error code E-4472 and HTTP status 422.
The limit was raised from 128 to 256 in v3.4.0.
For longer routes, split them into several missions chained with the follow_up field.
